newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil called up 50-75 cts, Brent up 10-12 ct.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil called up 50-75 cts, Brent up 10-12 ct.

text.p: IPE oil futures were expected to start slightly firmer amid uncertainty over the outcome of a meeting between the U.N. and Iraqi officials in Baghdad and a reluctance to further short the market, brokers said.
IPE gas oil was called 50 to 75 cents stronger at the open, up from Friday's settle of $162 a tonne, while IPE Brent crude was anticipated starting some 10 to 12 cents stronger.
Brent closed on Friday at $18.09 a barrel and was talked up some 10 cents on SIMEX, which was untraded.
"I just think the market is reluctant to break down at the moment, crude is holding now in a narrow range," said a broker.
